title: znote language
description: What znote needs to know about one language to find names in it. Add a file named after the language code to support another language.

code.description: BCP 47 language code, the same as the file name.

stopwords.description: Lower-case words that are never a name on their own, even when the name finder tags them at the start of a sentence.

suffixes.description: Endings a name can carry in running text ("Acmes", "Rotterdamse"). They are hidden together with the name.

prefixes.description: Beginnings written onto a name in running text, such as attached articles. They are hidden together with the name.

sentenceEnds.description: What ends a sentence, so one hit of the name finder is not read across two sentences.

scaleWords.description: Words or letters that scale an amount, such as "k" or "miljoen".

phoneTrunks.description: The digits a national phone number starts with, such as "0".
